issue_context.title: Tying step size for generic_thermostat to precision has degraded its functionality
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/41972

This change prevents the thermostat from displaying the actual temperature, instead it now jumps only on 'precision' steps. It therefore has degraded the usefulness.

Tying it to the thermostats precision makes sense at first glance but makes setting the temperature in the UI a pain. I'd say 0.1 precision is common for displaying temperature and setting thresholds, but I'd imagine it's fairly rare for people to actually adjust their thermostats in 0.1 increments. Using something like a separate step_size would satisfy all use cases.

**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

core-2021.2

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

_No response_

Home Assistant OS
